title: tibouchina citrina
intro: Tibouchina citrina, commonly known as the Lemon Blue Sage, is a plant species belonging to the Acanthaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues, making it a popular choice in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Tibouchina citrina include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its healing effects. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
